This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Mix well, scraping up any flavourful bits from the bottom of the pan. 5. Simmer the filling: Return the chicken to the pan and simmer gently for around 10–15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has reduced slightly. 6. Add the cheese: Stir in the cream cheese until smooth, then add the grated smoked Applewood cheese. Mix until melted and creamy. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Allow the filling to cool before assembling the pie. 7. Assemble the pie: Preheat the oven to 200°C conventional / 180°C fan / Gas Mark 6. Transfer the cooled filling to an ovenproof pie dish. Lay the puff pastry over the top, trim any excess and press the edges down to seal. Cut a small slit in the centre to allow steam to escape. 8. Egg wash and bake: Brush the pastry with beaten egg and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until the pastry is puffed up and beautifully golden. 9. Serve: Allow the pie to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Crispy bang bang chicken with jasmine rice. Quick and delicious homemade dinner.  For the chicken marinade 500g chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 egg 1 tbsp dark soy sauce 1 tsp sesame oil 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp black pepper Salt, to taste (use sparingly because the soy sauce is salty) For the crispy coating 1/2 cup cornflour (cornstarch) 1 cup plain flour ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder  1 tsp all purpose seasoning  ½ tsp black pepper Oil, for frying For the bang bang sauce 1/2 cup mayonnaise 3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce 2 tbsp sriracha (adjust to taste) 1–2 tsp lemon juice, to taste Method 1. Marinate the chicken Add the chicken pieces to a bowl with the egg, dark soy sauce, sesame oil and seasonings. Mix thoroughly until every piece is coated. Leave to marinate for 15–30 minutes if time allows. 2. Prepare the coating In a separate bowl, combine the cornflour, plain flour, paprika, garlic powder and black pepper. Mix well. 3. Coat the chicken Take each piece of marinated chicken and coat it in the flour mixture. Press the coating onto the chicken to help create a crispy, crunchy exterior. Shake off any excess flour. 4. Fry the chicken Heat the oil in a deep, heavy-based pan over medium heat. Fry the chicken in batches for approximately 5–8 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces, turning as needed until golden and crispy. Ensure the chicken is cooked all the way through and reaches an internal temperature of 75°C. Drain on a wire rack or kitchen paper. 5. Make the bang bang sauce In a bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sweet chilli sauce, sriracha and lemon juice. Stir until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust the sweetness, spice and tanginess to your liking. 6. Coat and serve Add the freshly fried chicken to the sauce and toss until each piece is evenly coated. Serve immediately while the chicken is still crispy. #dinnerideas #chickendinner #crispychicken #quickrecipes #easyrecipes

Ένα εύκολο, πεντανόστιμο γεύμα που θα φτιάχνεις ξανά και ξανά! 🤤 ΥΛΙΚΑ: 500 γρ. κιμά κοτόπουλο 1 κρεμμύδι (σωταρισμένο με λίγο ελαιόλαδο ή νερό, για να μαλακώσει) 1 καρότο, τριμμένο 2-3 σκ. σκόρδο 4 φρυγανιές (εγώ χρησιμοποίησα ολικής άλεσης)  1 κγ. πάπρικα 1/2 κγ. ρίγανη 1 κγ. δυόσμο 1 ματσάκι φρέσκο μαϊντανό  2 κσ. μουστάρδα 2 κσ. cottage cheese 1 αυγό Αλάτι Πιπέρι Για τη σάλτσα: 1 κρεμμύδι 2-3 σκ. σκόρδο 500 ml σάλτσα ντομάτας 1 κούπα νερό 1 κσ. σάλτσα pesto calabrese, προαιρετικά Λίγο μπούκοβο Αλάτι Πιπέρι Για τα κεφτεδάκια, θα χρειαστεί να σωτάρεις το κρεμμύδι σε λίγο ελαιόλαδο ή λίγο νερό, μέχρι να μαλακώσει. Μπορείς ωστόσο, να προσθέσεις και το κρεμμύδι σε μικρά κομμάτια, χωρίς να το σωτάρεις. Στη συνέχεια, βάζεις όλα τα υλικά σε ένα μπολ και τα ανακατεύεις πολύ καλά. Ιδανικά, αφήνεις για 2-3 ώρες τον κιμά στο ψυγείο για να σφίξει και να αρωματιστεί. Πλάθεις στο επιθυμητό σχήμα και τα βάζεις σε ένα ταψί με αντικολλητικό χαρτί. Ρίχνεις λίγο ελαιόλαδο από πάνω και ψήνεις στους 180°C για περίπου 40 λεπτά, μέχρι να πάρουν χρώμα. Για τη σάλτσα, σωτάρεις το κρεμμύδι και το σκόρδο σε λίγο ελαιόλαδο και μόλις μαλακώσουν προσθέτεις τη σάλτσα ντομάτας, νερό, μπούκοβο, αλάτι και πιπέρι. Βράζεις για περίπου 15 λεπτά μέχρι να μειωθεί η υγρασία και προσθέτεις τα κεφτεδάκια. Αφήνεις να δέσουν όλα μαζί και τέλος προσθέτεις τριμμένη παρμεζάνα. Creamy Garlic Chicken & Potatoes 🧄🥔🤍 The coziest comfort food! Tender, seasoned chicken and buttery baby potatoes tossed in a rich, creamy garlic Parmesan Alfredo sauce. This is the kind of dinner that tastes like a hug! Ingredients * 1½–2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1½ lbs baby new potatoes, cut in half * 4 tbsp butter, divided * 4–5 cloves garlic, minced * 2 cups heavy cream * 1–1½ cups freshly grated Parmesan cheese * 1 tsp garlic salt * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper, or to taste * 1 tbsp olive oil * Fresh parsley, optional Directions 1. Boil the potatoes: Wash the baby potatoes and cut them in half. Add to a pot of salted water and boil for 12–18 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain and set aside. 2. Cook the chicken: Season the chicken with garlic salt, onion powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken until golden brown and cooked through (165°F internally). Remove and set aside. 3. Make the creamy garlic sauce: Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the remaining 2 tbsp butter and minced garlic to the same skillet. Sauté for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the heavy cream, scraping up the flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 4. Add the Parmesan: Let the cream gently simmer for 3–5 minutes, then gradually stir in the Parmesan until melted and smooth. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. 5. Bring it all together: Return the chicken to the skillet and add the boiled, halved potatoes. Gently toss everything in the creamy garlic sauce and simmer for another 2–3 minutes until heated through and coated in all that goodness. 6. Serve: Sprinkle with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Serve warm with your favorite veggie or crusty bread to soak up that creamy sauce! Save this one for your next cozy dinner night! 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ChickenAndPotatoes #EasyDinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #DinnerRecipes
